text:
alice: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's latency incident — want to lock owners/timelines for SLO/SLA updates and recurring mitigation playbook.

alice: TL;DR: 99th pct spikes traced to hot shard redis contention + bursty batching on serving-runtime. Error budget burned ~4% yesterday.

alice: Proposed immediate changes:
- tighten 95th target from 120ms -> 100ms for customer tier beta (temporary)
- add 99th guardrail alert at 450ms (current is 600ms)
- add a throughput cap route for bursty customers to protect shared pool

raj: +1 to the guardrail alert. Question: do we want to change global SLO or create a per-pool override?

maya: per-pool override preferred. I'll add panels to the SLO dashboard for pool A/B comparison. Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/slo/pool-comparison (WIP)

becka: I can own the serving-runtime batching change. Plan: short-term patch to reduce max batch size from 64->32, rollout canary tomorrow morning. ETA 72h for canary then full rollout.

raj: I'll take infra side — increase soft-eviction on redis hot keys, add key TTL on cache-warmup path. ETA 1 week.

alice: Action items summary (for clarity):
- becka: implement batch-size cap + canary (72h)
- raj: redis eviction/TTL changes + monitoring (1w)
- maya: dashboard updates, new 99th guardrail panels (48h)
- alice: update SLO doc + notify sales/support of temporary 95th change (today)

alice: Timeline: aim to have all mitigations deployed and monitor for two full burn cycles (14 days) before we revert any temporary SLO relaxations.

slo-bot: automated: error budget alert triggered: service=api-serving, window=7d, burn=27% (threshold 20%). Incident reference: 2251234567.

maya: dashboard query for 99th pct (PromQL): `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool, route))`

becka: note: canary will include traffic split 5% -> 25% over three steps. Will post deploy IDs here.

raj: can we also add an alert for sustained burstiness (requests/s spike > 2x median for >3m) to preempt this?

alice: yes — add that to the guardrail ticket. I'll create a short follow-up ticket with owners+links and assign in JIRA.

alice: final ask: owners, please react with :thumbsup: once you ack timelines. I'll send the notification to support/sales after 3pm PT.

becka: :thumbsup:
raj: :thumbsup:
maya: :thumbsup:
